description: Drive block for controlling and supervising one unidirectional motor/drive.

inputs.name: FbkRun
inputs.description: Contactor/run feedback from the motor starter or drive.

inputs.name: ElAvail
inputs.description: Electrical availability input. FALSE blocks start and trips the drive.

inputs.name: Overload
inputs.description: Thermal or mechanical overload healthy signal.

inputs.name: AutModLo
inputs.description: Local/automatic or repair switch signal depending on configuration.

inputs.name: StopLoc
inputs.description: Local stop signal from field switch or pushbutton.

inputs.name: StartLoc
inputs.description: Local start signal from field switch or pushbutton.

inputs.name: IntStaE
inputs.description: Essential start interlock.

inputs.name: IntStart
inputs.description: Start interlock.

inputs.name: IntOpE
inputs.description: Essential operating interlock.

inputs.name: IntOper
inputs.description: Operating interlock.

inputs.name: IntProtG
inputs.description: General protection interlock active in all modes.

inputs.name: IntProtA
inputs.description: Protection interlock active in automatic and selected manual modes.

inputs.name: IntStop
inputs.description: Stop interlock for sequential stopping.

inputs.name: ProFB
inputs.description: Process feedback from a process feedback block, such as speed monitor.

inputs.name: MsgEn
inputs.description: Message enable input.

inputs.name: StartAut
inputs.description: Automatic start command input.

inputs.name: StopAut
inputs.description: Automatic stop command input.

inputs.name: QuickStp
inputs.description: Quick-stop command input.

inputs.name: SimoStat
inputs.description: Status from SIMOCODE adapter block.

inputs.name: AV_Perc
inputs.description: Analog percentage value, typically motor current or power.

inputs.name: StaDelTi
inputs.description: Start delay time.

inputs.name: StpDelTi
inputs.description: Stop delay time.

inputs.name: GR_LINK1
inputs.description: Primary group or route link input.

inputs.name: GR_LINK2
inputs.description: Secondary group or route link input.

inputs.name: MUX_LINK
inputs.description: Link from C_MUX when drive belongs to more than two groups/routes.

outputs.name: RunSig
outputs.description: Drive running signal used as feedback and as interlock for other objects.

outputs.name: DynFlt
outputs.description: Dynamic fault indication, not yet acknowledged.

outputs.name: ContOn
outputs.description: Contactor ON command output to motor starter or subcontrol block.

outputs.name: O_LINKQ
outputs.description: Object link output for slave objects such as annunciations, measurements, and process feedback blocks.
